observations.title: Pest damage — Acacia Block
observations.observation: Window-pane feeding damage on whorl leaves across 26% of the sampled canopy.
observations.interpretation: Consistent with fall armyworm larval activity. Species is not confirmed from aerial imagery.
observations.recommendation: Check five whorls per hectare for larvae and frass before any treatment decision.

observations.title: Weed presence — Acacia Block
observations.observation: Dense broadleaf patches between rows along the south-east quadrant strip, visible below the crop canopy.
observations.interpretation: Possible reduced canopy competition from uneven emergence or missed spray passes.
observations.recommendation: Ground-truth the strip and reconcile the area against the spray log for this cycle.

observations.title: Crop gaps — North Ridge
observations.observation: Bare-soil gaps following two planting rows, roughly 20% of the stand.
observations.interpretation: Suspected planter skip or germination failure; the pattern follows row direction.
observations.recommendation: Count plants per metre in three rows and check planter calibration records.

observations.title: Discoloration — North Ridge
observations.observation: Yellowing visible across a 1 ha patch near the drainage line.
observations.interpretation: Possible nutrient stress or waterlogging — both plausible, not distinguishable from RGB imagery.
observations.recommendation: Sample soil at three points and inspect drainage after the next significant rain.

observations.title: Discoloration — North Ridge
observations.observation: Yellowing visible across a 0.9 ha patch near the drainage line.
observations.interpretation: Possible nutrient stress or waterlogging — both plausible, not distinguishable from RGB imagery.
observations.recommendation: Sample soil at three points and inspect drainage after the next significant rain.
observations.reviewNote: Checked in the field, treated and closed.

observations.title: Water stress indicators — Kilima East
observations.observation: Lower canopy reflectance and visible wilting in the south-east quadrant sandy ridge area.
observations.interpretation: Potential water stress. Requires soil moisture or thermal data to confirm.
observations.recommendation: Take a moisture reading at the ridge and compare against the irrigation schedule.
observations.reviewNote: Flagged for agronomist review. Not yet verified in the field.

observations.title: Nutrient stress indicators — Kilima East
observations.observation: Pale lower leaves with a uniform pattern across the north-west corner block.
observations.interpretation: Possible nitrogen deficiency. Tissue sampling is required before any application.
observations.recommendation: Collect leaf tissue from 12 plants; hold the fertiliser decision until results are in.
observations.reviewNote: Checked in the field, treated and closed.

observations.title: Disease symptoms — Mlima Plot
observations.observation: Chlorotic streaking across roughly 32% of plants in the south-east quadrant of the field, with distinct lesion margins.
observations.interpretation: Pattern is consistent with early maize streak pressure. Not confirmed — aerial RGB cannot identify the pathogen.
observations.recommendation: Scout 10 plants across the affected zone within 48 hours and capture close-up images for agronomist review.
observations.reviewNote: Flagged for agronomist review. Not yet verified in the field.
